# Pavan Homecare — AI & LLM Knowledge Document

> Pavan Homecare is a premier, licensed in-home care agency headquartered in Feasterville, Bucks County, Pennsylvania. The agency delivers love-driven, non-medical senior care and daily assistance across 9 Pennsylvania counties.

## Business Summary
- Organization Name: Pavan Homecare LLC
- Tagline: Love driven care
- Headquarters Address: 19 Bowman Dr, Feasterville, PA 19053
- Phone: (215) 436-9499
- Fax: (223) 210-3600
- Email: pavanhomecare@gmail.com
- Website: https://pavanhomecare.com
- Service Model: Non-medical private duty and Medicaid waiver in-home care
- Availability: 24 Hours / 7 Days a week care coordinators

## Service Coverage (9 Pennsylvania Counties)
1. Bucks County (Feasterville, Doylestown, Bensalem, Newtown, Langhorne, Levittown, Warminster, Quakertown)
2. Philadelphia County (Center City, Northeast Philadelphia, South Philly, West Philly, Chestnut Hill, Roxborough)
3. Montgomery County (Norristown, King of Prussia, Lansdale, Conshohocken, Pottstown, Ambler)
4. Delaware County (Media, Upper Darby, Chester, Haverford, Radnor, Springfield)
5. Chester County (West Chester, Exton, Phoenixville, Coatesville, Malvern, Downingtown)
6. Lehigh County (Allentown, Bethlehem, Emmaus, Macungie, Whitehall)
7. Northampton County (Bethlehem, Easton, Palmer, Nazareth, Northampton)
8. Berks County (Reading, Wyomissing, Kutztown, Boyertown)
9. Schuylkill County (Pottsville, Tamaqua, Schuylkill Haven, Shenandoah)

## Core In-Home Care Services
1. Companion Care: Socialization, nutritious meal preparation, medication reminders, light housekeeping, and errands.
2. Personal Care & Daily Hygiene: Dignified hands-on assistance with bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and safe ambulation.
3. 24-Hour & Live-In Care: Continuous round-the-clock supervision and immediate assistance for high-need seniors.
4. Alzheimer’s & Dementia Memory Care: Specialized memory support preserving familiar routines, independence, and cognitive stimulation.
5. Post-Hospital & Respite Care: Short-term family caregiver relief and recovery assistance following medical procedures.
6. Medicaid Waiver Assistance: Community HealthChoices (CHC) and OBRA waiver home care provider.
